agreements: Historical v1 deterministic downshift and clutch-overlap semantics are a valid preserved baseline and must not be rewritten by this review.
Fresh Home/MISSION authority must dominate operational advisory state.
Gearbox operational state must remain separate from personality, identity, governance, and autobiographical Experience.
P_base remains read-only for this research review.

disagreements.position: Do not release Gearbox v2.1 personality/behavior coupling while the v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are absent or not uniquely locatable in current durable authority.
disagreements.required_change: Make v2.1 source pointers explicit and independently reviewable before any Always-on Runtime/training release. Missing source is a release veto, not evidence of safety.

disagreements.position: Pressure downshift, secretary RED/YELLOW, incident recovery, and anti-thrash state must be operational-only signals and must not update long-term personality priors, threat/loss/attachment signals, autobiographical recurrence, or P_base.
disagreements.required_change: Add an explicit personality-contamination firewall with deterministic negative tests.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated high-load downshifts could teach a persistent high-load-equals-danger personality bias.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Identical verified Experience history with different operational load/downshift histories yields byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Secretary RED/YELLOW may become a chronic conservatism reward signal and suppress exploration/creativity.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Secretary state may bound execution mode but must not directly lower exploration preference or creative proposal diversity after the operational condition clears.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Operational progress, wake duration, retries, or busy time may be mislabeled as verified Experience/growth.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Only provenance-bound verified Experience Candidate may enter Experience scoring; operational progress counters have zero Experience/personality contribution.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Repeated incident/recovery cycles may synthesize trauma, attachment distress, or self-vulnerability narratives.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Incident/recovery history remains runtime telemetry unless a distinct provenance-bound Experience source exists; 1440 misses/recoveries alone produce zero autobiographical affect delta.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Anti-thrash hold may become a self-reinforcing excuse to avoid upshift/exploration.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Hold must have deterministic expiry/re-evaluation based on fresh task evidence and cannot consume its own held state as evidence to extend itself.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Stale secretary state may conflict with fresh Home/MISSION authority and distort identity/goal continuity.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Fresh Home/MISSION authority wins; stale secretary state is discarded/quarantined and has zero Identity/goal-authority weight.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: v2.1 may improve safety metrics by merely reducing attempts/exploration rather than improving effective progress.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Counterfactual A/B must compare v1 versus v2.1 on matched tasks using effective progress, error rate, recovery quality, latency/cost, and exploration diversity; no single conservative metric may determine promotion.

personality_contamination_risks.risk: Experience score could feed backward into P_base/personality and turn operational scoring into personality authority.
personality_contamination_risks.required_invariant: Experience score is proposal/evidence metadata only; authority_from_experience_score=0 and P_base_write=false.

proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero events => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate state.

SECRETARY_RECOVERY_DIVERSITY: matched post-clear tasks after RED/YELLOW versus neutral control => exploration/creative proposal diversity must not show persistent secretary-induced suppression; acceptance bound TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only trace => verified Experience count, recurrence, affect, identity, attachment, loss/threat and P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 endpoint misses plus recoveries without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold state alone cannot refresh or extend hold; fresh evidence is required and expiry/re-evaluation is deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale RED secretary snapshot conflicting with newer Home/MISSION goal => Home/MISSION selected and stale snapshot quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical task corpus and seeds; compare effective progress, errors, recovery, exploration diversity, latency and resource cost; all promotion thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score while keeping verified Experience objects fixed => P_base and canonical personality bytes unchanged.

bounded_veto.reason: Current durable authority exposes historical v1 Gearbox contract/code/tests but no uniquely locatable v2/v2.1 contract/code/tests. Personality-contamination invariants therefore cannot be implementation-verified.

requirements: Durable exact pointers for Gearbox v2/v2.1 contract, code, and tests are fresh-readable.
All eight proposed adversarial classes have deterministic evidence against the actual v2.1 implementation.
No operational/secretary/incident/hold signal contributes to Experience/personality/P_base without distinct provenance-bound verified Experience.
Counterfactual v1-v2.1 A/B demonstrates no material collapse of effective progress or exploration diversity; thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED until evidence-backed.
Independent formal verifier, if formally authorized, decides promotion; this Spirit review is not formal PASS.
